auto_download.description: Enable or disable automatic key download over the local network via mDNS

manual_fingerprint_entry.description: Enable or disable manual fingerprint entry as fallback when QR scanning fails

signing_email.description: Email address to use as the sender for encrypted signature emails; if empty, defaults to GnuPG's configured default

allowed_interfaces.description: List of local network interface names allowed for key exchange; empty means all interfaces

qr_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for QR code scanning before timeout

audio_fingerprint_mode.description: Enable audio-based fingerprint transmission (e.g., via speaker/mic); only on supported platforms
